Get CFA-WM data, optionally filtered by version

get_data.Rd

Convenience accessor for all_data. Returns the full combined dataset by default, or a subset restricted to one or more study versions.

Usage

get_data(version = "all", data = aphantasiaWMStrats::all_data)

Arguments

version

Character vector. One or more of "v1", "v2", "v3", or "all" (the default). "all" is equivalent to c("v1", "v2", "v3") and cannot be combined with the others.

data

Internal. The data frame to filter; defaults to all_data and is not meant to be set by end users. Exposed as an argument (rather than referencing all_data directly in the function body) so the filtering/validation logic can be tested against a small synthetic stand-in without touching the real package data.

Value

A tibble with the same columns as all_data, filtered to the requested version(s).

Examples

get_data()
#> # A tibble: 8,614 × 69
#>    id                version language   age gender vviq_total_score vviq_group_2
#>    <chr>             <chr>   <chr>    <int> <chr>             <int> <chr>       
#>  1 aacu640913909790… v1      fr          41 f                    16 aphantasia  
#>  2 aacu640913909790… v1      fr          41 f                    16 aphantasia
